memory_candidates: A gate script's own plan-time probe count can be stale by the time a phase runs: verify append-only array edits structurally from the diff (insertions/deletions) rather than from a predicted total.

An unbounded nondeterministic deadline in a time-indexed step relation is infinite-branching on whichever side the reset fires; moving the reset between the discharge and the commitment state only swaps the failing side, so a liveness-commitment encoding must finitize the deadline to get two-sided finite branching.
Avoid the literal token 'sorry' (including 'sorryAx') in Lean file prose when a phase's verification criterion is 'grep -c sorry = 0'.
